verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own bill-pay flow where invoices are 'routed for approval, and paid' with fewer clicks, plus dynamic approval routing across teams. That makes routing payments to approvers a first-party capability, but the evidence never shows a finance lead granting payment-approval permissions to designated teammates or a one-click approve-and-send action. missing for 10: documented approver/payment-permission configuration for designated teammates, explicit one-click approve-and-pay flow, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set up approval permissions so designated teammates can approve and send payments with one click

citations.quote: routed for approval, and paid — 7x fewer clicks than Bill.com
Dynamic approval routing with parallel workflows across finance, IT, legal, and security
